title: ColorfulEnchantsGlint
description: Improved rainbow enchantments glint resource pack.
body:
## ColorfulEnchantsGlint Lightweight resource pack that replaces default enchanted glint with rainbow one. ### Tinkering Resource pack contains `python` `gen.py` script to regenerate pattern with configurable constants in it. ### Suggestions & Support **Need a specific version support? Or maybe a new feature?**
Send your issue request to [Github Issues](https://github.com/OpenMCTeam/ColorfulEnchantsGlint/issues) or email me `yavarenikya@gmail.com`.
